candidates.snippet: -268: Reign as Mauryan Emperor - Ashoka began his reign as the third emperor of the Maurya Empire, ruling over a vast territory in ancient India. -260: Kalinga War - Ashoka waged a brutal war against the Kalinga kingdom, resulting in immense loss of life and a profound personal transformation. -259: Adoption of Buddhism - Deeply affected by the Kalinga War, Ashoka converted to Buddhism and began promoting its teachings throughout his empire. -250: Edicts Promulgated - Ashoka issued numerous edicts on pillars and rocks across his empire, disseminating his principles of dhamma (righteousness).
